profile.headline: Senior Full Stack Engineer and Architect
profile.summary: I currently work for IBM as a Senior Software Engineer in the Data and AI organization.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer - Band 9
positions.description:
* Senior Full Stack Developer for IBM watsonx BI assistant. The BI assistant provides data-aware recommendations to business problems with relevant visualizations and summaries so users can make informed decisions without being an expert in data analytics. I'm responsible for the development and implementation of a robust public API Service and Storage layer, ensuring secure management of user-generated conversations and messages, as well as data generated by AI micro-services. Ensured compliance with relevant data protection regulations and standards, while prioritizing performance and integration capabilities.

* Founder, Chief Architect and Technical Leader for IBM’s HyperBlue start-up Unreal Data. Unreal Data is
an Enterprise Software As A Service offering for creating scalable AI-based simulations across business
domains using synthetic data and statistical data relationships. The first multi-tenant Generally
Available version was released on Dec 2022 on the AWS platform. As the technical leader for this
startup, I was responsible for all aspects of development, delivery and management of a global team.
Worked along side with the “CEO” of the company to drive the product forward, manage budget and
resources, and build a culture and identity as a brand within IBM.

* Technical Lead and Architect for IBM Data Privacy for Cloud Pak for Data.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer - Band 8
positions.description:
* Architect and Technical Leader for IBM’s Data Privacy as an add-on service of the Watson Knowledge
Catalog portfolio in the Data and AI organization. The service offers an effortless experience to select
and mask subsets of data from different production data sources and warehouses to use for data
science purposes. The systems posses a sophisticated subsetting engine that generates complex subset
queries of any relation database. It uses the generated queries to fetch data, mask the sensitive fields
and write the result to a different target relation database. I was responsible for building many
components and micro-services from scratch for this product but the most outstanding component was
the core of the subsetting engine which led to an Outstanding Technical Achievement Award.

* Developer Lead for IBM DB2 Augmented Data Explorer. Focused on building a query engine module to
translate plain English queries to SQL syntax. Also, contributed in the Web Application side by
delivering important features to manage and create visualizations from query results.

* Founding Engineer, Architect and Technical Leader for IBM’s Machine Learning offering Regulatory
Accelerator on Cloud Paks for Data. Built this service from the ground-up with several proof of concepts
that were incubated in the Emerging Technology Organization. The project transitioned to a product
offering where I lead the development team of 6 Full-Stack Developers. This service streamlines the
process of complying with regulations by harnessing the power of machine learning. It helps alleviate
the hassle of complying with new regulations by reducing the amount of manual effort required to
comply.

positions.title: Computer Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Software Development.

- Linux environment.
- Wrote scripts in java to automate the process of data retrieval for thousands of users.
- MongoDB migration scripts to handle thousands of records.
- Exposure to AWS S3, WebKitGTK, Maven, and other technologies.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
• Designed and implemented a reliable and extensible API using the VMWare VCloud Java SDK. The API manages and coordinates virtual machine templates and it is a module of a large scale cloud application that runs as a ‘Platform as a Service’.

• Developed a RESTful web service using the Spring Framework and Tomcat 8 to leverage the aforementioned API's functionality. This web service includes web socket functionality between clients and the server.

• Designed and developed a cocoa application for internal use to access virtual machines and templates, add and edit metadata and other administrative functionalities. It uses web socket clients to connect to the web service and retrieve real-time updates when performing long operations such as capturing, cloning, un-deploying and deploying virtual machines.

• Exposure to Agile methodologies and cloud computing technologies.

positions.title: Web Developer & Graphic Designer
positions.description:
• Developed and maintained six websites for Metapo including their online (e-commerce) stores for different products such as robotic vacuums, uninterruptible power supplies and home cleaning supplies. 

     • Increased sales significantly through improved web layout designs by adding dynamic features,
       easy to use interface, eye-appealing graphics and designs. 

     • Researched and implemented search engine optimization (SEO) techniques to increase the
       websites’ traffic.  

• Designed products’ packaging, user manuals, and advertisements.

• Maintained all social media related websites and provided support to customers.

patents.title: SYNTHETIC DATA GENERATION
patents.description: Using a graphical user interface (GUI), a user is guided to generate a logical graph that represents how real data is generated in a situation. The situation is simulated using an artificial intelligence (AI) model a number of times by having the AI model choose paths through the logical graph to generate synthetic data that is representative of the real data. The AI model may also use a reward table that the user is guided to generate via the GUI to execute the simulation, wherein the reward table incentivizes certain paths of the logical graph, and agents of the AI model are trained using the values of this reward table. This synthetic data generated via the AI model can be used for training other AI models.
